entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Anshuman Singh, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State opposite party 1 and Mr. Pandey Balkrishna, the learned counsel representing first informant opposite party 2.

Applicant Subhash Patel @ Patel Subhash Chotelal, who is a charge sheeted accused, has approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr. P. C. with the following prayer:-

Prayagraj in Case Crime No. 02 of 2024, under Sections 376, 504 and 506 I.P.C.

Stay the further proceeding against applicant inSession Trial No. 1877 of 2024, (State Vs. Subhash Patel) Pending before AdditionalSession Judge F.T.C., Court no. 02,
Prayagraj in Case Crime No. 02 of 2024, under Sections 376, 504 and 506 I.P.C.
lodged against applicant at Police Station Kydganj, District Prayagraj.

Or may pass such other and further order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deems fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case; otherwise, the applicants shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."
After some arguments, it transpires that charges have already been framed against accused applicant by Court below in exercise of jurisdiction under Section 228 Cr. P. C.
As such, the present application has been rendered infructuous.
It is by now well settled that once the charges have been framed by Court below then Court is bound to answer charges so framed one way or other way.
In view of above, no effective relief can be granted to applicant in present application.
At this juncture, the learned A.G.A,. has relied upon judgement of Supreme Court in the case of Ratilal Bhanji Mithani Vs. State of Maharashtra, 1979 (2) SCC, 179.

sentences.text: In view of above, present application has now been rendered infructuous and therefore liable to be dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
It is, accordingly, dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
